label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Dos hombros juntados será a él a dos sus extremos, y será juntado.
spanish: Dos hombros que se junten será a él a dos sus extremos, y será juntado.
grammarChanges: Changed the passive participle 'juntados' to the active relative clause 'que se junten' so the shoulder-pieces join (qal active participle) rather than being joined, per the cited mismatch on h02028007003; left the later pual 'será juntado' untouched since that verb is already passive in the source.
readerNote: Rendered the qal active participle as 'que se junten' because Spanish has no bare active participle for this verb here.
